levels.surface: علي بن أحمد بن محمد الدقاق
أحمد بن يحيى بن زكريا القطان
بكر بن عبد الله بن حبيب

notes: Needs ruling (rule 11, «قال: و سألته» with no one named): «وَ سَأَلْتُهُ» names no new person and «فَقَالَ لِي» has no name in this route, so the Imam who answers is not added; the reading is left at Abd Allah b. Abi Hudhayl
«- ثم قال تميم بن بهلول حدثني أبو معاوية ...» is a later remark naming other transmitters for the same saying: variant. The bracketed «[بن]» is an editor's insertion, kept in the surface as written
